records.prompt:
Create an eight-cel character animation sprite sheet on a transparent background, EXACTLY TWO ROWS of FOUR distinct full-body cels. No text, numbers, ground, backdrop, effects, dust, other people, motion blur. Large transparent gaps; every hammer tip and both feet fully inside its own cel. All eight cels show the SAME fantasy game character from a FIXED ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER CAMERA: character faces diagonally DOWN-RIGHT (southeast), as image 3. See front of chest plus the character's right-facing profile. BOTH feet and hip axis follow this southeast facing. This is a more frontal diagonal than the pure side-facing pose references; preserve natural torso twisting.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is the APPROVED four-key-pose overhead movement and character proportions; image 2 is the APPROVED four-key-pose sweeping movement and same character design; image 3 controls ONLY CAMERA/FACING and costume details. Reproject the approved motions into this requested down_right facing. Keep the detailed hand-painted chibi style, face/beard, tied red-brown hair, red sash, purple-brown fur-trimmed clothes, bronze wrist guards, large rectangular purple-and-bronze hammer. Head/torso size and rigid medium-long wooden handle length constant in ALL eight cels. Do not shorten the handle during contact. Exactly TWO hands both gripping the same continuous shaft, close grip near its butt while swinging, natural wrists.
TOP ROW = FOUR OVERHEAD EXERCISE POSES, same order as image 1:
1. Both hands together above forehead, head of hammer high BEHIND crown, torso slightly back.
2. Deeper overhead load with raised elbows, hands together, tool head behind crown, rear-leg weight.
3. Both arms pull forward and tool head travels over crown in the character's forward direction, shoulders/hips begin hinging forward.
4. Deep forward body hinge and bent front knee, face looking down. Both hands together reach down and forward beyond front knee. LONG handle nearly VERTICAL downward from hands to hammer head resting on ground just ahead of boots. NOT a horizontal handle across belly. Match final pose of image 1, reprojected down_right view.
BOTTOM ROW = FOUR BROAD CROSS-BODY SWEEP POSES, same order as image 2:
1. Low preparation, tool head on character's low LEFT side near knee, handle crossing waist, shoulders coiled.
2. Load BOTH hands together beside RIGHT shoulder/temple; hammer head high behind opposite silhouette, torso rotated and rear leg loaded.
3. Extend both arms and rotate hips to sweep hammer across the FRONT of the body at chest height in a wide diagonal arc.
4. Follow through to low opposite LEFT side: hammer head LOW BESIDE LEFT knee, shaft diagonally UP to hands at RIGHT hip. It remains off the floor; do not plant it vertically. Torso visibly turned, knees flexed.
Keep feet planted at the same locations, same anatomical density through all poses. The requested down_right facing must be unambiguous. Each cel is independently drawn, no pasted neutral images. This is a solo heavy-tool movement demonstration with no contact with other beings.
